answer_1.quote: Natural language generation (NLG) The final task of the DS is to generate the system response, based on the predicted system dialogue act.
answer_1.outputs: Generated system responses and user utterances in dialogues

answer_2.quote: The proposed model is evaluated in terms of the inform rate (Info), the success rate (Succ), and BLEU.

answer_4.quote: The human assessment of dialogue quality is performed to confirm the improvements of the proposed methods. 400 dialogues, generated by the two trained agents, are evaluated by 14 human assessors.
answer_4.guideline: Each assessor is shown a comparison of two dialogues and offers judgement regarding: Which dialogue system completes the task more successfully (DS Success)? Which user simulator behaves more like a real human user (US Human-like)? Which dialogue is more natural, fluent and efficient (Dialogue Flow)?
